==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Widely praised for his knowledge and understanding of the game, and considered one of the best Junglers in Korea.
* Reached rank 1 in the Korean soloqueue in Season 8.
* After [[Griffin (Korean Team)|Griffin]]'s loss against [[Gen.G]] in the [[LCK/2018 Season/Regional Finals|2018 Korea Regional Finals]], Tarzan changed his name to "만족하지않을거야" which translates to "I will not be satisfied."
* Was known for 100 percent win-rate {{ci|Trundle}} in Season 8.
* Was known for reaching very high elo in Korean solo queue playing off role.
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on March 28, 2025.
** The 52nd player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on April 05, 2025.
** Was the 34th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on September 20, 2025.
** The 23rd player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on September 14, 2025.
** The 39th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.=
=== Individual Awards ===
* LCK KDA Leader Jungle x2 (Spring 2019, Summer 2019)
* LPL 1st All Pro Team x2 (Summer 2021, Split 1 2025)
* LPL 2nd All Pro Team x3 (Summer 2024, Split 2 2025, Split 3 2025) 
* LPL 3rd All Pro Team x2 (Spring 2022, Spring 2023)
* LPL Playoffs FMVP x1 (Split 2 2025)
